$comment: The clothing sets to draw whole on the figure (public #772), in order. Pieces name the wear place the bars measure; a ramp is dark to light hex steps, taken from the source named in colour_source. Frames counted per race for stand and walk; right views are the left ones mirrored by code and never drawn twice. Work, fight and the other clips are not drawn here: #771 redraws them on 45 frames.

figure.note: The kept 35 degree takes, the figure of the painted lands. The live kit's walk sheets (human 11 frames x 3 views x 2 builds, elf 16, skeleton 13) are the older drawing.

skeleton.note: the skeleton's kept front and back walks are 16 frame takes

frames.other_clips_not_drawn_here: human 23 clips / 215 frames in the pack of #764, elf and skeleton alike; redrawn on 45 frames by #771

sets.title: Reed-walker
sets.why: the one set a player can wear in the live game: reed hat and reed sandals, craftable at the workshop
sets.race_order: human first; elf and skeleton after the human's passes

pieces.name: Reed hat
pieces.colour_source: dried reed straw, with a band of the berry-dyed cord (core/dyed-cord, the berry sprite's red)
pieces.look: a low-crowned woven reed hat with a wide brim that clears the skull outline and sits above the brow, a berry-red cord band

pieces.name: Reed sandals
pieces.look: flat woven reed soles with two cord straps over the foot and one round the ankle; the toes stay bare

sets.description: Dress this figure in a reed hat and reed sandals only. Hat: low flat-crowned woven pale straw hat, wide brim, thin red cord band; crown no taller than the hair was, brim above the eyebrows so forehead, eyes and face stay fully visible, a little brown hair at the temples. Sandals: very thin flat woven straw soles hugging the feet, cord straps, toes bare; feet keep their size and ground line. Body, face, skin, grey shorts, pose and size stay exactly the same.

description_by_race.elf: Dress this figure in a reed hat and reed sandals only. Hat: low flat-crowned woven pale straw hat, wide brim, thin red cord band; crown no taller than the hair was, brim above the eyebrows so forehead, eyes and pointed ears stay fully visible. Sandals: very thin flat woven straw soles hugging the feet, cord straps, toes bare; feet keep their size and ground line. Body, face, ears, hair, skin, grey clothes, pose and size stay exactly the same.
description_by_race.skeleton: Dress this skeleton in a reed hat and reed sandals only. Hat: low flat-crowned woven pale straw hat, wide brim, thin red cord band; crown no taller than the skull was, brim above the eye sockets so the whole skull face stays visible. Sandals: very thin flat woven straw soles under the bone feet, cord straps, toes bare; feet keep their size and ground line. Skull, bones, ribs, pose and size stay exactly the same.

sets.title: Digger leathers
sets.why: CLOTHING section 8; the numbers are built by the clothing wave (public #769), the look does not wait

pieces.name: Boiled-leather cap
pieces.colour_source: the roe hide's coat (content/kit/core/creatures/roe.png: bark ramp), the hide's colour is final
pieces.look: a close boiled-leather skull cap with a stitched seam and a short peak, clearly a cap and not hair

pieces.name: Boiled-leather boots
pieces.look: ankle-high stiff leather boots with a folded cuff and a thick sole

sets.description: Dress this figure in a leather cap and leather boots only. Cap: a close-fitting tan-russet boiled-leather skull cap with a stitched seam and a short peak, clearly a cap and not hair, above the eyebrows so forehead, eyes and face stay fully visible. Boots: ankle-high stiff russet leather boots with a folded cuff and a thick sole. Body, face, skin, pose and size stay exactly the same, grey shorts keep the same grey.

sets.title: Hardened leathers
sets.why: CLOTHING section 8; rare tier; numbers in public #769

pieces.name: Hardened jerkin
pieces.colour_source: the roe hide's coat (bark ramp), hardened so one step darker
pieces.look: a sleeveless hardened-leather jerkin laced up the front, the neck and the shoulders left bare so the chin and face stay clear

pieces.name: Hardened breeches
pieces.colour_source: the roe hide's coat (bark ramp), hardened
pieces.look: knee-length hardened-leather breeches over the shorts, a plain belt

sets.description: Dress this figure in a hardened leather jerkin and breeches only. Jerkin: a sleeveless dark-brown hardened leather jerkin laced up the front, ending below the collarbones; the neck, shoulders, arms and chin stay bare and uncovered. Breeches: plain knee-length hardened leather breeches with a plain belt, replacing the grey shorts. Head, hair, face, arms, shins, feet, pose and size stay exactly the same.

bars.S1: height within 2 px of the bare frame (128 px frame), feet rows within 1
bars.S2: outside the garment's area the figure is unchanged (face, hair, skin) by no more than the measured noise of the trial's A still
bars.S3: nothing of the garment inside the face box, on every frame
bars.S4: the garment's area changes by at most 12% between neighbour frames and its colours stay on the set's ramp
bars.S6: by eye at 4 times on the painted village-edge plate at zoom 3, 13:00 and dusk

view_clauses.back: Seen from behind, facing away; keep it facing away.
view_clauses.left: Side view facing left; keep the same profile.
